deviation: The draft swaps New York law and New York County courts for Ohio law and exclusive Ohio courts. Ohio is not a neutral law, so it falls outside both the playbook position and the fallback (neutral law only, with Legal approval). Arcadia would also have to litigate in a distant forum. The added escalation step (12.2) and the equitable-relief clause (12.3) are not in the standard. They do not change the governing law or forum issue.
suggested_text: 12.1 This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or relating to it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles. 12.2 The Parties shall first attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through discussions between senior representatives. Subject to that, the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party submits to their jurisdiction. 12.3 Each Party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages are an inadequate remedy, and that the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief without proof of actual damages.
